about_the_game:
Prepare for a chaotic top-down, fast-paced shootout where you, as the Sphere, will fight the straight lines and rigid angles. Start with basic skills and grind your way through hordes of minions to collect money and unlock new abilities. Each run offers a unique combination of skills to take on a challenging boss. Defeat it to collect their essence and unlock powerful elemental ultimates.

Game Features:

  • Start Your Engines: Choose from a set of initial skills to gear up for the chaos of combat.

  • Battle the Basics: Survive relentless waves of geometric foes until the boss emerges.

  • Collect to Conquer: Amass experience and gold to enhance your Sphere's capabilities.

  • Power Up and Press On: Use your stash of gold to unlock transformative abilities and return stronger.

  • Ultimate Geometric Showdown: Defeat all five Platonic Solids to claim your place in the heavens of shapes.

Rise of the Sphere

Start in the realm of basic shapes, armed only with your wits and initial skills. Shoot, dodge, and weave through waves of lesser forms in a merciless battle against time and geometry.

Loot, Level, and Dominate

Collect experience and gold from fallen adversaries, leveling up your Sphere's stats and strengthening your skills.

Rinse and Repeat with Rewards

Didn't make it? No problem. Use the gold stashed from previous runs to beef up your Sphere with stronger stats and unlock new skills through game-changing Power Ups.

Summon and Conquer

Prove your worth by defeating enough lesser forms to summon the dreaded Platonic Bosses. Each boss battle is a test of endurance, skill, and your ability to think outside the cube.

Face the Final Five

Each run brings you closer to the ultimate challenge: defeating each of the five Platonic Solids, earning their essence and unlocking the ultimate elemental skills.

Ready your reflexes, sharpen your strategy, and may the best solid win!
